name: Financial Industry Services
short: PT FAST Indo Talenta (FITALENTA) provides expert solutions for the financial industry, focusing on leadership, sales, business coaching, and HR strategies. With 20+ years of experience, we help companies achieve sustainable growth.
description:
Financial Industry Services

At PT FAST Indo Talenta (FITALENTA), we empower clients in the financial industry by providing comprehensive, tailored services designed to elevate business performance and drive sustainable growth. Our expertise spans across multiple facets, ensuring that organizations can thrive in a competitive and ever-evolving financial landscape.

Our key services include:

  • Leadership & Sales Empowerment: We provide training programs that enhance both the hard and soft skills of your workforce, from branch managers to sales staff, ensuring they meet and exceed organizational targets.
  • Business Monitoring & Coaching: Our hands-on coaching and monitoring services are designed to support business leaders in maintaining discipline, creativity, and motivation across their teams, with regular reviews and tailored guidance.
  • HR Strategy to Improve Productivity: We help you refine your HR processes through psychometric assessments, competency analysis, and tailored recruitment strategies to ensure the right talent is in the right position, enhancing overall organizational productivity.
  • Culture & Business Transformation: FITALENTA assists in fostering a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship within your organization, driving long-term transformation through targeted programs that build both individual and team capabilities.

With over 20 years of director's experience in the financial sector, FITALENTA is dedicated to being a lifetime partner for companies aiming to achieve financial success through innovative training methods, strategic HR practices, and personalized business assistance.

name: Human Capital Program
short: PT FAST Indo Talenta (FITALENTA) connects businesses with top talent through curated, competency-based recruitment solutions. Streamline your hiring process and secure the right people for your team.
description:
Human Capital Program Services

At PT FAST Indo Talenta (FITALENTA), we are dedicated to helping companies find, attract, and secure the best talent through our comprehensive Human Capital Recruitment services. With a focus on competency-based recruitment, we offer customized solutions to match your company's unique needs, whether it's filling permanent positions, internships, or outsourcing roles.

Key Features of Our Recruitment Services:

  1. Talent Pool Access: We maintain a web-based talent database compiled through collaborations with leading universities, training institutions, and labor departments.
  2. Customized Recruitment Schemes: FITALENTA works closely with your team to understand your business objectives and talent requirements, then curates a pool of candidates specifically tailored to meet these needs.
  3. Flexible Recruitment Models: Internship Programs, Outsourcing Services, and Headhunting for highly skilled professionals or executives.
  4. End-to-End Support: From analyzing your company's needs to the final hiring and contract agreements, our team is with you every step of the way.
  5. Collaborative International Recruitment: We work with international partners to send skilled workers abroad, including Japan, Taiwan, Australia, and Kyrgyzstan.
  6. Success Stories: Pribadi School, Labschool UPI, and Wakaf Salman ITB showcase our ability to provide tailored recruitment solutions across various industries.

In addition to recruitment, FITALENTA offers job preparation training and competency enhancement programs standardized by the National Professional Certification Agency (BNSP), developed in collaboration with more than three professional BNSP certification and training institutions.

Branding & Marketing Program

name: Management Program
short: Management Program is designed to support philanthropic and CSR initiatives through professional project management, including ZISWAF distribution, borewell construction, MCK, and mosque construction.
description:
FITALENTA's Management Program is designed for philanthropic organizations, foundations, NGOs, and CSR initiatives seeking a reliable implementation partner for social impact projects, including clean water, sanitation, religious infrastructure, and community development programs.

One of our key initiatives is professional ZISWAF (Zakat, Infaq, Sadaqah, and Waqf) distribution management, covering well drilling, sanitation facilities (MCK), and mosque construction.

Key Features of Our Services

  • Needs Assessment & Field Verification: Comprehensive site surveys and beneficiary assessments.
  • Project Execution & Field Management: End-to-end coordination including stakeholder engagement, vendor management, and quality supervision.
  • Documentation & Transparency Support: Professional photo, video, and field documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Impact Reporting & Handover: Structured reporting on achievements, beneficiary reach, and implementation results.
  • ZISWAF Site Survey & Geoelectrical Testing: For borewell projects, ensuring accurate drilling points.
  • Borewell, Sanitation & Mosque Construction: Comprehensive implementation as part of the ZISWAF distribution program.

Support for ZISWAF-funded community infrastructure projects across regions including Aceh, West Java, South Sumatra, and other areas.

name: Basic Certificate Category C (Avionics)
short: FITALENTA's Basic Certificate Category C (Avionics) is a comprehensive aviation training program designed to equip aspiring aviation professionals with foundational knowledge and technical competencies.
description:
FITALENTA's Basic Certificate Category C (Avionics) is a comprehensive training program designed to equip aspiring aviation professionals with foundational knowledge and technical competencies in aircraft avionics, integrating Avionics Training, Basic Certificate Category C certification pathway, and Career Connection into a structured learning journey.

Program Highlights

  1. Avionics Training: Develop fundamental technical knowledge and practical competencies in aircraft avionics through structured, industry-oriented training.
  2. Basic Certificate Category C: Gain the required training pathway toward Basic Certificate Category C (Avionics) certification.
  3. Career Connection: Connect with industry opportunities and gain career insights to support your transition from training into the aviation workforce.
  4. Industry-Oriented Learning: A curriculum designed to bridge technical education with the competencies required in the aviation industry.

Designed for D3/S1 graduates and students from engineering, science, and related technical backgrounds.

TRAINING → CERTIFICATION → CAREER CONNECTION
